data.title: The Red Route
data.text: You broke the Upper Vell dam. When it went, the lake came down the stream along the red route Anna had drawn on the handover map. The village had practised the green one. Farther down, the fjord chapel broke. Its notice board sent anyone looking for someone to the lists at the church hall in Carran; everyone on them was accounted for. Tomas's chalet is still standing, kettles and all. In his letter he asked for a new stake line, higher up, where ice remained. I have set his letter beside Anna's map. Tomas signed, “Love, T.”

data.text: The Upper Vell dam held for ten summers. Then it went, and the lake came down the stream by the red route Anna had drawn on the handover map.
